en.s: The Battle of Ichi-no-Tani (一ノ谷の戦い, Ichi-no-Tani no tatakai) was fought between the attacking Minamoto clan and the defending Taira clan at Suma, to the west of present-day Kobe, Japan, on 20 March 1184. It sat on a very narrow strip of shore, between mountains on the north, and the sea to the south. This made it quite defensible, but also made it difficult to maneuver troops inside the fortress.

zh.s: 1184年3月20日，源氏军队在今日本神户以西的须磨，进攻平氏守军，爆发一之谷之战。平氏据点位于一条非常狭窄的海岸地带，北侧是山，南侧是海，易于防守，但堡垒内部也难以调动兵力。

en.s: The Battle of Raciborz took place in the Polish town of Raciborz, on 20 March 1241, during the Mongol invasion of Poland. It ended in the victory of a Polish army from Silesia, commanded by Duke of Opole and Raciborz, Mieszko II the Fat. On March 20, 1241, units of the Mongol Army reached the Oder near Raciborz, and began to cross the river. Duke Mieszko II the Fat, aware of this, decided to attack the invaders while they were busy trying to get across the Oder. With an unknown number of knights, he attacked the Mongols, killed probably 400 Asiatic warriors, and defeated them.

zh.s: 1241年3月20日，蒙古入侵波兰期间，拉齐布日发生战斗。奥波莱与拉齐布日公爵‘胖子’梅什科二世率领的西里西亚波兰军队获胜。当日，蒙古部队抵达拉齐布日附近的奥得河，开始渡河。梅什科得知后，决定趁敌人忙于过河时进攻。他带领人数不详的骑士突袭蒙古军队，据推测杀死约400名战士，将其击败。

en.s: The Battle of Nibley Green was fought near North Nibley in Gloucestershire on 20 March 1470, between the troops of Thomas Talbot, 2nd Viscount Lisle and William Berkeley, 2nd Baron Berkeley. It is notable for being the last battle fought in England entirely between the private armies of feudal magnates.

zh.s: 1470年3月20日，第二代莱尔子爵托马斯·塔尔博特，与第二代伯克利男爵威廉·伯克利的军队，在格洛斯特郡北尼布利附近交战。这是英格兰最后一场完全由封建贵族私人军队之间进行的战斗。

The battle was fought on March 20, 1528, between King János Szapolyai of Hungary, and Austrian forces under command of Bálint Török and Johann Katzianer, a Styrian mercenary commander of Ferdinand I, Holy Roman Emperor. The battle was the second military defeat for Szapolyai.

zh.s: 塞尼亚战役于1528年3月20日在今斯洛伐克塞尼亚附近发生，该地匈牙利语名为锡瑙、今称奥包乌伊锡瑙。交战双方为匈牙利国王约翰·绍波尧伊，以及巴林特·特勒克和约翰·卡齐亚纳率领的奥地利军队。卡齐亚纳是神圣罗马皇帝斐迪南一世麾下的施蒂里亚雇佣军指挥官。这是绍波尧伊的第二次军事失败。

en.t: The Dutch East India Company is established
en.s: The United East India Company (Dutch: Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie [vərˈeːnɪɣdə oːstˈɪndisə kɔmpɑˈɲi]; abbr. VOC [veː(j)oːˈseː]), commonly known as the Dutch East India Company, was a chartered trading company and one of the first joint-stock companies in the world. Established on 20 March 1602 by the States General of the Netherlands amalgamating existing companies, it was granted a 21-year monopoly to carry out trade activities in Asia.

zh.s: 联合东印度公司（荷兰语：Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie，简称VOC），通常称为荷兰东印度公司，是一家获特许经营权的贸易公司，也是世界上最早的股份公司之一。荷兰三级会议于1602年3月20日将已有的贸易公司合并，成立该公司，并授予其21年的亚洲贸易垄断权。

en.s: The siege of Frankenthal was a siege of the Palatinate campaign during the Thirty Years' War. A Spanish army under Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba besieged the Palatinate fortified city of Frankenthal and its mostly English garrison commanded by John Burroughs. The siege lasted from 1621 to 20 March 1623, when King James I ordered the city to surrender.

en.s: The Battle of Ain Dara occurred in the village of Ain Dara, in Mount Lebanon in 1711, between the Qaysi and Yamani, two rival tribo-political factions. The Qays were led by Emir Haydar of the Shihab dynasty and consisted of the Druze clans of Jumblatt, Imad, Nakad Talhuq, and Abd al-Malik and the Maronite clan of Khazen.

zh.s: 1711年，凯西派与也门派这两个相互对立的部落政治派系在黎巴嫩山的艾因达拉村交战。凯西派由希哈布王朝的海达尔埃米尔领导，成员包括朱姆布拉特、伊马德、纳卡德、塔尔胡克和阿卜杜勒·马利克等德鲁兹家族，以及马龙派的哈赞家族。

en.s: The Great Boston Fire of 1760 was a major conflagration that occurred on March 20, 1760, in Boston in the Province of Massachusetts Bay. The fire destroyed 349 buildings in the area between the modern Washington Street and Fort Hill, as well as several ships in port, and it left more than a thousand people homeless.

zh.s: 1760年3月20日，马萨诸塞湾省波士顿发生大火，摧毁今华盛顿街与堡垒山之间地区的349栋建筑，以及港内数艘船只，使1,000多人无家可归。

en.s: The Battle of Heliopolis was fought between the French Army of the Orient under the command of General Jean-Baptiste Kléber and an Ottoman army at Heliopolis on 20 March 1800. The French were victorious, inflicting over 9,000 casualties on the Ottomans while suffering only 600 killed or wounded.

zh.s: 1800年3月20日，克莱贝尔将军指挥的法国东方军团与奥斯曼军队在赫利奥波利斯交战。法军获胜，使奥斯曼军队损失9000多人；法军有600人阵亡或受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Braga or Battle of Póvoa de Lanhoso or Battle of Carvalho d'Este (20 March 1809) saw an Imperial French corps led by Marshal Nicolas Soult attack a Portuguese army commanded by Baron Christian Adolph Friedrich von Eben. Soult's professional soldiers slaughtered large numbers of their opponents, who were mostly badly disciplined and poorly armed militia. The action occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. Braga is situated about 45 kilometres (28 mi) north-northeast of Porto (Oporto). The British won a tactical victory over Soult's II Corps in the Battle of Corunna on 16 January 1809.

zh.s: 布拉加战役又称波瓦-迪拉尼奥苏战役或卡瓦略德埃斯特战役，于1809年3月20日发生。尼古拉·苏尔特元帅率领法国帝国军一个军，进攻克里斯蒂安·阿道夫·弗里德里希·冯·埃本男爵指挥的葡萄牙军队。苏尔特训练有素的士兵大量杀伤了对手，后者多为纪律差、武器不足的民兵。此战发生于拿破仑战争中的半岛战争，布拉加位于波尔图东北偏北约45公里（28英里）。此前，英国曾于1809年1月16日在科鲁尼亚战役中，对苏尔特的第2军取得战术胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Limonest (20 March 1814) saw 53,000 Austrian and Hessian troops led by Prince Frederick of Hessen-Homburg attack 23,000 French troops under Marshal Pierre Augereau. After some stiff fighting, the Allies forced the outnumbered French defenders to withdraw from a line of hills north of Lyon in this War of the Sixth Coalition action. Lyon, in 1814 the second largest city in France, was abandoned to the Allies as a direct result of the defeat. While Napoleon faced the main Allied armies of Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg and Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher to the east of Paris, a secondary campaign was conducted near Lyon to the south.

zh.s: 1814年3月20日，黑森-洪堡的弗里德里希亲王率53,000名奥地利与黑森士兵，进攻皮埃尔·奥热罗元帅指挥的23,000名法军。在这场第六次反法同盟战争的战斗中，双方激战后，盟军迫使兵力较少的法军从里昂以北的一线丘陵撤退。战败直接导致当时法国第二大城市里昂被放弃，落入盟军手中。拿破仑当时在巴黎以东与施瓦岑贝格亲王卡尔·菲利普及格布哈德·莱贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔率领的盟军主力作战，南面的里昂附近则进行着一场次要战役。

en.s: Ludwig I or Louis I (German: Ludwig I.; 25 August 1786 – 29 February 1868) was King of Bavaria from 1825 until the 1848 revolutions in the German states. When he was crown prince, he was involved in the Napoleonic Wars. As king, he encouraged Bavaria's industrialization, initiating the Ludwig Canal between the rivers Main and the Danube.

en.s: Uncle Tom's Cabin; or, Life Among the Lowly is an anti-slavery novel by American author Harriet Beecher Stowe. Published in two volumes in 1852, the novel had a profound effect on attitudes toward African Americans and slavery in the U.S., and is said to have "helped lay the groundwork for the American Civil War". Stowe, a Connecticut-born teacher at the Hartford Female Seminary, was part of the religious Beecher family and an active abolitionist.

zh.s: 1852年3月20日，美国作家哈丽雅特·比彻·斯托的反奴隶制小说《汤姆叔叔的小屋》以两卷本出版。小说深刻影响了美国社会对非裔美国人和奴隶制的看法，甚至被认为为南北战争创造了舆论条件。斯托出生于康涅狄格州，曾在哈特福德女子神学院任教，出身比彻宗教家族，也是积极的废奴主义者。

en.s: In the 19th century, Nicaragua was beset by political issues among liberals and conservatives, allowing William Walker, an American Southerner seeking to establish English-speaking slavery states in Latin America, to ascend to the Nicaraguan presidency. Walker believed in the doctrine of manifest destiny, and established himself in Nicaragua in the guise of offering help to liberals , but his real intentions were to conquer the five provinces of Central America, a manifesto he titled "Five or None."

zh.s: 19世纪的尼加拉瓜政局受到自由派与保守派纷争困扰。美国南方人威廉·沃克试图在拉丁美洲建立讲英语的蓄奴州，并借此登上尼加拉瓜总统之位。沃克信奉“天定命运论”，表面上以援助自由派为由在尼加拉瓜立足，实际意图却是征服中美洲五个省份，并将这一主张称为“五个全得，否则一个不留”。

en.s: The Battle of Vaught's Hill, also known as the Battle of Milton, was a battle of the American Civil War, occurring on March 20, 1863, in Rutherford County, Tennessee. During the inactivity following the Battle of Stones River, a Union brigade-sized reconnaissance force, under Col. Albert S. Hall, left Murfreesboro on March 18. Circling to the northeast, Hall encountered Confederate Brig. Gen. John Hunt Morgan's cavalry command, which caused him to fall back to a position east of Milton. Pursuing Hall, Morgan's men caught up with him on the morning of March 20, at Vaught's Hill.

zh.s: 沃特山战役又称米尔顿战役，于1863年3月20日在田纳西州卢瑟福县发生，是美国内战的一场战斗。石河战役后，双方行动暂缓。3月18日，阿尔伯特·S.霍尔上校率北军一个旅规模的侦察部队离开默弗里斯伯勒，向东北迂回时遭遇约翰·亨特·摩根准将的南军骑兵，被迫退至米尔顿以东。摩根率部追赶，于3月20日上午在沃特山追上霍尔。

en.s: The Evacuation of Fredericia was part of the Second Schleswig War and began on March 20, 1864, with a bombardment by Austrian and Prussian troops. The evacuation of the Fredericia fortress on April 28 effectively marked the end of Danish resistance in Jutland.

en.s: The March 1874 Galway Borough by-election was held on 20 March 1874. The by-election was held due to the succession to a peerage of the incumbent Home Rule MP, William St Lawrence. It was won by the Home Rule candidate Frank Hugh O'Donnell. An election petition alleged bribery and intimidation on the part of O'Donnell's supporters, and his election was declared void under the Parliamentary Elections Act 1868.

en.t: Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
en.s: The Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property, signed in Paris, France, on 20 March 1883, was one of the first intellectual property treaties. It established a Union for the protection of industrial property. The Convention is currently still in force. The substantive provisions of the Convention fall into three main categories: national treatment, priority right and common rules.

zh.t: 保护工业产权巴黎公约签署
zh.s: 《保护工业产权巴黎公约》于1883年3月20日在法国巴黎签署，是最早的知识产权条约之一，并建立了保护工业产权的联盟。原文记载，该公约仍然有效。其实体规定主要分为三类：国民待遇、优先权和共同规则。

en.s: Romen Theatre (Russian: Московский музыкально-драматический театр "Ромэн") in Moscow, Russia, is the oldest and the most famous of Romani theatres in the world. The theatre is a key object of Romani culture in Russia, and from the moment of its foundation in 1931, it has been a centre of attraction for Romani artists in Russia.

zh.t: 首部罗姆语轻歌剧在莫斯科首演
zh.s: 1888年3月20日，首部罗姆语轻歌剧《森林之子》在莫斯科马利剧院首演，由罗姆人剧团独立演出。这段罗姆人戏剧传统后来发展为莫斯科的“罗曼”剧院；剧院于1931年创立，是世界上历史最久、最著名的罗姆人剧院之一，也是俄罗斯罗姆人文化和艺术家汇聚的重要场所。

en.t: Emperor Wilhelm II dismissed Otto von Bismarck as the chancellor of the German Empire
en.s: Otto Eduard Leopold, Prince of Bismarck, Count of Bismarck-Schönhausen, Duke of Lauenburg (1 April 1815 – 30 July 1898), was a German statesman and diplomat who oversaw the unification of Germany and served as its first chancellor from 1871 to 1890. Bismarck's Realpolitik and firm governance earned him the nickname Iron Chancellor (Eiserner Kanzler). From Junker landowner origins, Bismarck rose rapidly in Prussian politics under King Wilhelm I of Prussia.

zh.t: 德皇威廉二世解除奥托·冯·俾斯麦的德意志帝国首相职务
zh.s: 奥托·爱德华·利奥波德·俾斯麦（俾斯麦亲王、舍恩豪森伯爵、劳恩堡公爵；1815年4月1日—1898年7月30日）是德国政治家和外交官，主导了德国统一，并于1871年至1890年担任首任德国首相。他奉行现实政治并以强硬方式执政，因此被称为“铁血宰相”（Eiserner Kanzler）。俾斯麦出身容克地主家庭，在普鲁士国王威廉一世统治时期迅速崛起于普鲁士政坛。

en.t: The first of a series of auctions of sheep farming land in southern Patagonia takes place impacting established settlers
en.s: In late 19th and early 20th centuries, sheep farming expanded across the Patagonian Steppe making the southern regions of Argentina and Chile one of the world's foremost sheep farming areas. The sheep farming boom attracted thousands of immigrants from Chiloé and Europe to southern Patagonia. Early sheep farming in Patagonia was oriented towards wool production but changed over time with the development of industrial refrigerators towards meat export.

zh.t: 巴塔哥尼亚南部一系列牧羊地拍卖中的首场举行，影响了当地已定居者
zh.s: 19世纪末至20世纪初，牧羊业在巴塔哥尼亚草原不断扩张，使阿根廷和智利南部成为世界主要牧羊地区之一。牧羊业繁荣吸引数千名移民从奇洛埃岛和欧洲前往巴塔哥尼亚南部。当地早期牧羊业以羊毛生产为主，后来随着工业制冷设备发展，逐渐转向肉类出口。

en.s: The 1910 Copa del Rey final (UECF) was the 8th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey (although technically there was no final, with the tournament being played as a mini-group of three teams). It was one of two rival Cup competitions played in that year due to disagreements between the tournament's reigning champion, Club Ciclista de San Sebastián, and some of the clubs invited. This was the "unofficial" competition, organised by the UECF (Unión Española de Clubes de Fútbol), in San Sebastián. Both its winner and that of the rival, the newly created FEF (Federación Española de Fútbol), later Royal Spanish Football Federation (Spanish: Real Federación Española de Fútbol, RFEF) in Madrid played two months later, are currently recognised as official by the RFEF. The final was contested by Athletic Bilbao (then known as Athletic Club) and Vasconia, and was held at Ondarreta Stadium, San Sebastián on 20 March 1910.

zh.s: 1910年西班牙国王杯决赛（UECF）是该赛事的第八届决赛。严格来说，这届赛事没有单场决赛，而是由三支球队进行小组赛。同年因卫冕冠军圣塞巴斯蒂安自行车俱乐部与部分受邀俱乐部意见不合，出现了两项互相竞争的杯赛。这项由西班牙足球俱乐部联盟（UECF）在圣塞巴斯蒂安举办的赛事被视为“非官方”杯赛。两项赛事的冠军——另一项由新成立的西班牙足球联合会（FEF，后来成为西班牙皇家足球联合会，RFEF）在马德里举办——于两个月后交手；RFEF如今都承认两项赛事的冠军。决赛于1910年3月20日在圣塞巴斯蒂安的翁德雷塔球场举行，由毕尔巴鄂竞技（当时称Athletic Club）对阵巴斯科尼亚。

en.t: Song Jiaoren is shot at Shanghai Railway Station
en.s: Song Jiaoren (Chinese: 宋敎仁; pinyin: Sòng Jiàorén; Wade–Giles: Sung Chiao-jen, [sʊ̂ŋ tɕjâʊɻə̌n]; 5 April 1882 – 22 March 1913) was a Chinese republican revolutionary and one of the founding leaders of the Kuomintang (KMT). An advocate of a parliamentary cabinet system to check the powers of Yuan Shikai, Song led the KMT to victory in China's first democratic election before being assassinated in Shanghai on 22 March 1913.

zh.t: 宋教仁在上海火车站遭枪击
zh.s: 1913年3月20日，宋教仁赴北京途中在上海火车站遭近距离枪击，两天后伤重去世。宋教仁是中华民国革命者、国民党创建者之一，主张以议会内阁制制衡袁世凯，并曾率国民党赢得中国首次民主选举。

en.t: In the Curragh incident, over 100 British Army officers threaten to resign if ordered to march against the Ulster Volunteers
en.s: The Curragh incident of 20 March 1914, sometimes known as the Curragh mutiny, occurred in the Curragh, County Kildare, Ireland. The Curragh Camp was then the main base for the British Army in Ireland, which at the time still formed part of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. Ireland was scheduled to receive a measure of devolved government, which would include the northern province of Ulster, later in the year.

zh.s: 柯拉事件发生于1914年3月20日，地点在爱尔兰基尔代尔郡的柯拉，有时也称“柯拉兵变”。当时，柯拉营是英国陆军在爱尔兰的主要基地，而爱尔兰仍属于大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国。爱尔兰原计划在当年获得一定程度的自治，其中也包括北部的阿尔斯特省。超过100名英国陆军军官威胁称，如果奉命向阿尔斯特志愿军进军，他们就会辞职。

en.t: Albert Einstein submits his paper, "The Foundation of the General Theory of Relativity", which establishes his general theory of relativity, to the journal Annalen der Physik
en.s: Albert Einstein (14 March 1879 – 18 April 1955) was a German-born theoretical physicist best known for developing the theory of relativity. Einstein also made important contributions to quantum theory. His mass–energy equivalence formula E = mc2, which arises from special relativity, has been called "the world's most famous equation". He received the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics for "his services to theoretical physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect".

zh.t: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦将论文《广义相对论的基础》提交给《物理学年鉴》，确立了他的广义相对论
zh.s: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦（1879年3月14日—1955年4月18日）是出生于德国的理论物理学家，以创立相对论而闻名。他也为量子理论作出了重要贡献。他从狭义相对论导出的质能等价公式E = mc²被称为“世界上最著名的方程式”。他因“对理论物理学的贡献，尤其是发现光电效应定律”而获得1921年诺贝尔物理学奖。

en.s: Operation Alberich (Unternehmen Alberich) was the codename of a German Army military operation in France during World War I. It was a planned withdrawal to new positions on the shorter, more easily defended Hindenburg Line (Siegfriedstellung), which took place between 9 February and 20 March 1917 and eliminated the two salients which had been formed in 1916, between Arras and Saint-Quentin and from Saint-Quentin to Noyon, during the Battle of the Somme. The British referred to it as the German Retreat to the Hindenburg Line but the operation was a strategic withdrawal rather than a retreat.

zh.s: ‘阿尔贝里希行动’是第一次世界大战期间德军在法国实施的军事行动代号。1917年2月9日至3月20日，德军有计划地撤至更短、更易防守的兴登堡防线，又称齐格菲阵地，消除了1916年索姆河战役形成的两个突出部，分别位于阿拉斯至圣康坦之间，以及圣康坦至努瓦永之间。英国称其为‘德军撤退至兴登堡防线’，但这实际上是一次主动的战略撤离。

en.s: The 1920 New South Wales state election was held on 20 March 1920. The 24th parliament of New South Wales was dissolved on 18 February 1920 by the Governor, Sir Walter Edward Davidson, on the advice of the Premier William Holman. The election was for all of the 90 seats in the 25th New South Wales Legislative Assembly, and it was the first to be conducted with multi-member electorates, using the Hare-Clark single transferable vote system.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州于1920年3月20日举行州选举。州督沃尔特·爱德华·戴维森爵士应州长威廉·霍尔曼的建议，于1920年2月18日解散第24届州议会。本次选举改选第25届新南威尔士州立法议会全部90个席位，也是首次采用多席选区和黑尔-克拉克单记可让渡投票制。

en.s: The Upper Silesia plebiscite was a plebiscite mandated by the Versailles Treaty and carried out on 20 March 1921 to determine ownership of the province of Upper Silesia between Weimar Germany and the Second Polish Republic. The region was ethnically mixed with both Germans and Poles. According to prewar statistics, ethnic Poles formed 60 percent of the population.

The incident solidified Chiang's power immediately before the successful Northern Expedition, turning him into the paramount leader of the country.

en.s: The 2010 A-League Grand Final took place at Etihad Stadium in Melbourne, Australia on 20 March 2010. It was the final match in the A-League 2009–10 season, and was played between premiers Sydney FC and runners-up Melbourne Victory. Sydney FC won the match 4–2 on penalty shootout after drawing the game 1–1 and became the winners of the 2009–10 Championship in addition to their premiership. The A-League National Youth League Grand Final was held at Etihad Stadium prior to the main game. After coming 4th in the 2009–10 season, Gold Coast United won the youth title in their inaugural season, coming from a goal down to defeat Perth Glory, 2–1.

zh.s: 2010年澳超总决赛于3月20日在澳大利亚墨尔本的阿提哈德体育场举行，是2009—10赛季最后一场比赛，由常规赛冠军悉尼FC对阵亚军墨尔本胜利。双方1比1战平，悉尼FC在点球大战中以4比2获胜，在赢得常规赛冠军后又获得总冠军。主赛前，同一球场还举行了全国青年联赛总决赛。赛季排名第四的黄金海岸联，在落后一球后以2比1逆转珀斯光荣，于参加联赛的首个赛季夺得青年冠军。

All seats in the House of Assembly or lower house, whose current members were elected at the 2006 election, and half the seats in the Legislative Council or upper house, last filled at the 2002 election, became vacant.

en.s: The 2010 Tasmanian state election was held on 20 March 2010 to elect members to the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The 12-year incumbent Labor government, led by Premier of Tasmania David Bartlett, won a fourth consecutive term against the Liberal opposition, led by Will Hodgman, after Labor formed a minority government with the support of the Greens. The election was conducted by the Tasmanian Electoral Commission, an independent body answerable to Parliament.

en.s: The Second Battle of Benghazi was fought between army units and militiamen loyal to Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, and anti-Gaddafi forces in Benghazi on 19-20 March 2011 during the Libyan Civil War. The battle marked the start of a United Nations-mandated military intervention in the conflict, with fighter jets from the French Air Force attacking and destroying several pro-Gaddafi units, forcing them to retreat.

en.s: General elections were held in Haiti on 28 November 2010, having originally been scheduled for 28 February. Ten senators and all 99 deputies were to be elected. Presidential elections were also held. A run-off was originally scheduled for 16 January as no candidate received 50% of the votes cast. However, it was postponed until 20 March 2011 as election officials said they could not hold the runoff while awaiting results from re-polling, with results expected on 31 March.

zh.s: 海地于2010年11月28日举行大选，原定日期为2月28日。选举改选10个参议员席位和全部99个众议员席位，同时举行总统选举。由于没有候选人获得50%的选票，原定于1月16日举行的总统决选被推迟。选举官员表示，由于仍在等待重新投票的结果，无法按期举行决选，因此将投票推迟至2011年3月20日；结果预计于3月31日公布。

en.s: The 20 March 2012 Iraq attacks were the sixth simultaneous wave of bombings to hit Iraq during the insurgency and the second such major assault since the US withdrawal at the end of 2011. At least 50 people were killed and around 250 wounded in highly coordinated attacks spread out in at least 10 cities. The deadliest attack of the day took place in Karbala where twin bombings left 13 dead and 50 injured. In the northern city of Kirkuk a car parked in the parking lot of a local security office exploded, killing 13 and leaving almost 60 wounded.

zh.s: 2012年3月20日，伊拉克至少10个城市遭到高度协调的袭击，造成至少50人死亡、约250人受伤。这是叛乱期间第六轮同时发生的爆炸潮，也是美军2011年底撤出后第二次此类大规模袭击。当日最致命的袭击发生在卡尔巴拉，两起爆炸造成13人死亡、50人受伤。北部基尔库克一处安全机构停车场内的汽车爆炸，也造成13人死亡、近60人受伤。

en.s: The 2014 Kabul Serena Hotel attack was a mass shooting at the restaurant of the Kabul Serena Hotel, in Kabul, Afghanistan on March 20, 2014 for which the Taliban claimed responsibility. Four teenage gunmen entered the restaurant of the hotel, opening fire with handguns against patrons and sparking a three-hour standoff with Afghan security forces. At least nine people were reported killed in the assault, including five Afghans and four foreigners.

zh.s: 2014年3月20日，阿富汗首都喀布尔塞雷纳酒店餐厅发生大规模枪击，塔利班宣称负责。四名十几岁的枪手进入餐厅，用手枪向顾客开火，随后与阿富汗安全部队对峙三小时。据报道，至少9人遇害，包括5名阿富汗人和4名外国人。

en.s: The Battle of Hosn was a one-day battle during the Syrian Civil War around the village of Hosn and its proper center in the 900-year-old medieval Crusader castle of Krak des Chevaliers, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, that had been in the hands of rebel fighters along with Hosn itself since 2012. The Syrian Army's objective during the battle was to sever the rebels' supply routes for recruits and weapons coming in and out of Lebanon.

zh.s: 霍斯恩战役是叙利亚内战期间持续一天的一场战斗，战场位于霍斯恩村及其中心的克拉克骑士堡周边。这座有900年历史的中世纪十字军城堡是联合国教科文组织世界遗产，自2012年以来一直由反政府武装控制。叙利亚军队的目标是切断叛军经由黎巴嫩输送人员和武器的补给线。

en.s: Homenaje a Dos Leyendas 2015 (Spanish for "Homage to Two Legends") was a major professional wrestling event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) as part of their annual Homenaje a Dos Leyendas event series that started in 1996. The 2015 event was the 20th event in the series and took place on March 20, 2015 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, making it the first major CMLL event of 2015. The event paid tribute to CMLL founder Salvador Lutteroth, who is always honored at Dos Leyendas, and will also pay tribute to luchador El Faraón.

zh.s: 2015年‘致敬两位传奇’是世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的大型职业摔角赛事，属于自1996年开始的同名年度系列。这是该系列第20届赛事，于2015年3月20日在墨西哥墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，也是CMLL当年的首场大型赛事。赛事除致敬历届固定纪念对象、CMLL创始人萨尔瓦多·卢特罗特外，也致敬摔角手El Faraón。

en.s: A total solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's descending node of orbit on Friday, March 20, 2015, with a magnitude of 1.0445. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby totally or partly obscuring the image of the Sun for a viewer on Earth. A total solar eclipse occurs when the Moon's apparent diameter is larger than the Sun's, blocking all direct sunlight, turning day into darkness.

zh.s: 2015年3月20日星期五，月球在其轨道降交点附近发生一次日全食，食分为1.0445。日食发生时，月球运行到地球和太阳之间，从地球上的观察者看来，太阳会被全部或部分遮挡。日全食发生时，月球的视直径大于太阳，因此会遮住所有直射阳光，让白昼变暗。

en.s: Operation Rainbow was an operation launched by the Syrian Army, supported by Hezbollah and other allied militias, during the Syrian Civil War, following a successful operation which led to the military encircling Aleppo from the east side and reaching the city's northern approach. The aim of the operation, as the previous one, was to encircle Aleppo and cut rebel supply lines into the city, thus besieging rebel-held areas.

en.t: Syrian civil war: The Siege of Kobanî is broken by the People's Protection Units (YPG) and Free Syrian Army (FSA), marking a turning point in the Rojava–Islamist conflict
en.s: The siege of Kobanî was launched by the Islamic State (IS) on 13 September 2014, in order to capture the Kobanî Canton and its main city of Kobanî (also known as Kobanê or Ayn al-Arab) in northern Syria, in the de facto autonomous region of Rojava. By 2 October 2014, IS succeeded in capturing 350 Kurdish villages and towns in the vicinity of Kobanê, generating a wave of some 300,000 Kurdish refugees, who fled across the border into Turkey's Şanlıurfa Province.

zh.t: 叙利亚内战：人民保卫军（YPG）和叙利亚自由军（FSA）打破科巴尼围城，成为罗贾瓦—伊斯兰主义冲突的转折点
zh.s: 伊斯兰国（IS）于2014年9月13日发动科巴尼围城战，意图夺取科巴尼州及其主要城市科巴尼（也称Kobanê或艾因阿拉伯）；该地位于叙利亚北部、事实上自治的罗贾瓦地区。到2014年10月2日，伊斯兰国已成功占领科巴尼周边350个库尔德村庄和城镇，引发约30万库尔德难民潮，他们越境逃往土耳其尚勒乌尔法省。

en.t: Republic of the Congo presidential election, 2016
en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Republic of the Congo on 20 March 2016. It was the first election to be held under the constitution passed by referendum in 2015. President Denis Sassou Nguesso, who had exhausted the two-term limit imposed by the previous constitution, was allowed to run again due to the adoption of the new constitution.

en.s: General elections were held in Zanzibar on 20 March 2016. The 2016 election was conducted as a re-run of the annulled 2015 Zanzibari general election. en.s: Kassym-Jomart Kemeluly Tokayev (born 17 May 1953) is a Kazakh politician and diplomat who has served as the second president of Kazakhstan since 2019. He previously served as Prime Minister from 1999 to 2002 and as Chairman of the Senate from 2007 to 2011 and again from 2013 to 2019. Tokayev also held the position of Director-General of the United Nations Office at Geneva from 2011 to 2013.

zh.t: 托卡耶夫就任哈萨克斯坦代总统
zh.s: 2019年3月20日，努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫辞职后，卡瑟姆若马尔特·托卡耶夫就任哈萨克斯坦代总统，随后成为该国第二任总统。他是哈萨克斯坦政治人物和外交官，曾于1999年至2002年任总理、2007年至2011年及2013年至2019年两度任参议院议长，并于2011年至2013年担任联合国日内瓦办事处总干事。

en.t: Withdrawal of United States troops from Iraq (2020–2021)
en.s: After the defeat of the Islamic State in Iraq in 2017, Iraq and the United States began discussing the partial withdrawal of American combat troops from Iraq in December 2019. In January 2020, during massive protests in Iraq, and following the assassination of Iranian commander Qasem Soleimani with a U.S. reaper drone ordered by President Trump, the Iraqi Council of Representatives passed a non-binding measure to "expel all foreign troops from their country," including American and Iranian troops.

en.t: La Plume noire, an anarchist bookstore in Lyon, is targeted by an attack of the far-right, provoking a shock in Lyon's far-left circles
en.s: La Plume noire (English: The Black Feather) is an anarchist bookstore and publishing house located at 8 Rue Diderot in Lyon, France. Frequently targeted by Lyon's far-right movement, it serves as a gathering point for the city's anarchists and anti-fascists. Founded in 1989 by the Francophone Fédération Anarchiste (FA) in the Croix-Rousse district, the bookstore moved several times during its early years before settling in 1993 into a space it occupied until 2010.
